niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel bright or use light surfaces for core content, with strong readability, clear section hierarchy, restrained accents, and low visual clutter. They consistently favor layouts with generous spacing, obvious task structure, concise actionable content, and components that look complete and usable rather than decorative, promotional, or overly dense. They also like focused modals/cards that isolate the task and reduce background distraction.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong visual hierarchy with clearly grouped sections, prominent labels/titles, and obvious flow between content blocks rather than flat or fragmented layouts with competing elements.
Prefers high-contrast, easy-to-scan text and numerals with clear separation of title, metadata, labels, and supporting copy rather than dim, low-contrast, or weakly differentiated text.
Prefers simpler screens with fewer decorative or competing elements, where the main task or CTA is visually isolated and not diluted by extra icons, tabs, promo content, or background activity.
Prefers layouts with more whitespace, roomier cards, and clearer separation between sections and controls rather than tightly packed or compressed compositions.

Prefers interfaces that look functional and immediately usable, with visible controls, search/actions, clear selection states, and complete content rather than placeholder, decorative, or ambiguous interaction patterns.
Prefers calm, formal, utility-first presentation with restrained accent usage and less promotional or marketing-heavy styling.
Prefers solid, softly separated cards or contained panels with subtle depth/rounding over harsh outlined blocks, fragmented boxes, or visually heavy panel treatments.
